messages:
alec_infra: FYI — scheduled rolling reboots in az3 tonight 02:30-04:30 UTC. BIOS + driver patch. We'll cordon 4 nodes at a time and let scheduler drain. Expect ~8% capacity dip on hosted GPU pools. Ping if you have long jobs.

sam_ops: thanks. Are Dedicated/Dedicated-GPU customers on this window?

alec_infra: Dedicated pools are on a separate maintenance lane, not part of this. This only touches hosted pools: gpu-highmem, gpu-standard, burstedge. We'll route traffic off az3 burst routes during peak steps.

tony_oncall: Can we pre-seed KV caches to reduce cold-start latency after reboots? Last time cold KVs caused a lot of tail latency.

alec_infra: good call. Plan: run kv-seed at 01:30 UTC. Command: 

```
./kvcache-seed --region az3 --pools gpu-highmem,gpu-standard,burstedge --parallel 8 --verify
```
will monitor cache hit rates.

devex_jen: Heads up — clientX nightly batch is scheduled for 03:00 in az3. I'll coordinate moving it out. @product_miguel please confirm.

product_miguel: I'll reschedule clientX batch to 05:00 UTC and update runbook.

scheduler-bot: migrate-job-clientX triggered by product_miguel at 2026-03-23T00:45:00Z

sam_ops: quick cost note — shifting load to other regions will spike cross-region egress. Rough estimate +$1.2k if we reroute max throughput for 2 hours. Approve?

alec_infra: acknowledge. We'll flag billing and limit cross-region burst to essential traffic; fallback policy will route to quantized-smaller model if saturation triggers.

tony_oncall: Also add NIC firmware post-checks to the playbook. We saw NIC regressions after last driver roll.

alec_infra: will run verification script post-reboot: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/nic-check --after --pattern 'az3-*' || /opt/redwood/bin/alert-oncall --team infra`

sam_ops: :thumbsup: lgtm.

alec_infra: TL;DR: az3 rolling reboots 02:30-04:30 UTC, kv-seed 01:30, expected hosted capacity dip ~8%, Dedicated unaffected, expect small billing bump if heavy cross-region reroute. Posting incident-channel blurb and runbook link now: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/az3-reboot-2026-03-23
